post_test_amendment.reason: Input validation incorrectly assumed every serialized detection must have positive width/height. Installed scale_boxes clips xyxy to native boundaries; predictions in letterbox padding can collapse to zero area and pred_to_json saves them without a positive-area filter. Three-decimal serialization can also collapse very thin boxes. Existing saved predictions contain658 zero-area boxes, none at confidence0.25.
post_test_amendment.minimal_change: Prediction geometry admissibility w>0,h>0 changed to w>=0,h>=0; negative/NaN/out-of-bounds boxes still rejected. Every saved detection retained, zero-area IoU=0.
post_test_amendment.reporting: Pre-test plan remains original. Executed audit code is explicitly amended after test; no preregistration claim for adapter.

zero_area_predictions_retained.policy: All remain in saved AP inputs; IoU is zero; any at fixed confidence count as FP

fixed_confidence.definition: Fixed descriptive point, not selected on validation or test; rounded saved predictions

independent_coco_reference.definition: Independent pycocotools COCO AP on rounded saved predictions; global300 cap precedes per-class100/300; not the primary Ultralytics implementation

metric_comparison_note: COCO reference uses different matching/interpolation and rounded JSON. Differences are reported, not treated as a required equality or replacement primary metric.
